purpose: Generated images used only to exercise the probe's transport and normalization path. They are engineering fixtures, never evidence. They are deliberately named differently from the canonical REAL_PHYSICAL filenames so a copy or a path mistake cannot silently promote them.
hard_rules: These files MUST NOT be moved or copied into the canonical fixtures/multimodal/ paths.
These files can never satisfy T064, in any directory, under any declaration.
Results obtained from these files can never contribute to a G1 GO verdict.
Any inference record produced from these files is non-qualifying by construction.
provenance_note: These images were generated during the G1 spike. They were briefly placed at the canonical REAL_PHYSICAL paths, which caused the T064 blocker to clear silently; they were moved here and the gate was hardened so presence can never again be mistaken for provenance.
